newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Up to seven killed in NZ shooting rampage - Radio NZ.
newsitem.headline: Up to seven killed in NZ shooting rampage - Radio NZ.

text.p: One person was shot dead and there were unconfirmed reports that up to six others were killed after a gunman went on a shooting rampage in the central North Island town of Raurimu, Radio New Zealand said on Saturday.
The New Zealand Press Association earlier reported that police had arrested a 50-year-old man following the shooting.
The gunman was arrested after he fled into bush, NZPA reported. Planes and helicopters were called in to help police hunt the man down.
A 30-year-old man was shot in the face by the gunman and was flown to Palmerston North Hospital by helicopter. He was suffering moderate injuries and was reported to be in satisfactory condition.
At least three rescue helicopters flew the wounded to Palmerston North and Taumarunui Hospitals.
Police told residents the shooting, which began around 9 a.m. (2000 GMT Friday), was related to a domestic incident.
